snippet.title: Shipshaper | Tomas Sala & Wired Reunite
snippet.description:
6 years ago we partnered up with Tomas to release The Falconeer. Today, we sail again!

ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license. 

Tomas is a rare kind of developer; he builds worlds, not just games. Our relationship is based on trust and a shared desire to do things differently. ShipShaper is exactly that. It’s bold, creative, simple even, but it hands real control over to players in a way you don’t often see. We're super super excited to welcome ShipShaper into the Wired family!

Follow Wired: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WIRED
Play the demo now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339280/ShipShaper/
